$schema: T-335 detection-checks manifest — read by the round-8 review contract to classify a fresh finding as SHOULD-HAVE-BEEN-CAUGHT (a listed check already covers this finding's class) vs a genuinely new gap.

exitCodes.1: at least one check FAILed — a defect is live
exitCodes.2: the audit itself crashed or could not start
exitCodes.3: no FAIL, but at least one check is UNVERIFIABLE — the audit was blind tonight, not green (FAIL dominates when both occur)

paging.model: one DIGEST page per check per night (title, failing-row count, first 10 rows, pointer to the full report on the box) — never one page per row
paging.severityRule: P1 when the check has rows that were NOT present in the previous run (state persisted in the audit state dir); P2 for an unchanged backlog
paging.dedupeKey: detection-floor-<checkId>-<YYYY-MM-DD> for FAIL digests; detection-floor-unverifiable-<checkId>-<YYYY-MM-DD> for UNVERIFIABLE pages — date-scoped so the Notifier 30-minute cooldown cannot swallow the nightly digest
paging.unverifiablePages: every UNVERIFIABLE check pages P2; an UNVERIFIABLE check is never treated as a pass
